caseName: Louisiana ex rel. Schwegmann Bank & Trust Co. v. Jeansonne
caseNameFull: LOUISIANA ex rel. SCHWEGMANN BANK & TRUST CO. v. JEANSONNE, STATE BANK COMMISSIONER
attorneys: Charles A. O’Niell, Jr. for appellants.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The appeal is dismissed for want of jurisdiction. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for a writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
